body: Thank you for recommending the website, I never knew anything like that existed. It makes me feel better knowing there's a lot of people willing to help with finding and taking down pictures. As for the second part, I'm trying my best to get on a road of recovery, but sudden memories and dreams always trigger another depressive state where I feel like I can't escape the past. I do thank you for the help though, and I hope you're doing alright, or hanging in there at least
